task: Locate the latest research about gravitational waves that were uploaded to ArXiv this week and provide a brief summary of one article's main findings.
answer: Located the latest gravitational-waves research uploaded to ArXiv this week (2026-11-06 to 2026-11-13) using ArXiv Advanced Search with the term 'gravitational waves' and the dedicated Date range filter (Submitted date), sorted by Announcement date (newest first); 65 papers matched. Selected article: 'Leveraging Lensing-driven Early Warnings: Joint Detectability of lensed Gravitational Waves and their LSST Optical Counterparts' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14343) by Sourabh Magare, Anindya, Anupreeta More, Shasvath J. Kapadia, submitted 10 Nov 2026. Main findings: Gravitational lensing of gravitational waves can provide early-warning times of O(hours) to O(days) prior to the mergers of binary neutron stars (BNS) and neutron star-black hole (NSBH) systems, enabling electromagnetic observatories to capture transient emissions around merger time. The authors demonstrate the viability of jointly detecting gravitationally lensed BNS and NSBH mergers via gravitational waves during the O5 observing run, together with their associated kilonova counterparts using the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST).
